packs.description: For live streams: starting soon, just chatting, BRB and ending music; follower, sub, donation and raid alerts; air horn, cheers, fails (bonk, buzzer, sad trombone), chat reactions, a 3-2-1 Go announcer and transitions. Ctrl+Alt+3 air horn, Ctrl+Alt+4 bonk.

packs.description: For streams, casting, LAN parties and voice chat: arena crowd cheers and boos, air horn, a fighting-game announcer (3, 2, 1, Fight!, Multi kill, Flawless victory), shooter callouts, plays and memes. Hype music loops; Ctrl+Alt+1 hype music, Ctrl+Alt+3 the countdown.

packs.description: 483 sounds for everything, in 20 categories: memes (air horn, boom, bruh), comedy, game show buzzers, crowds, people, 25 animals, video game blips and power-ups, notifications, combat, impacts, whooshes, sci-fi, magic, horror, vehicles, household, nature ambiences, sports, music stings and party sounds.

packs.description: For podcasts, talk streams and live shows: intro, outro and background music, stingers, ba-dum-tss, bleep, audience laughs and applause, comedy sounds, game-show buzzers and studio sounds (phone, doorbell, typewriter).

packs.name: Halloween pack
packs.description: For Halloween parties, horror streams and pranks: screams, evil laughs and witch cackles, zombies and monster roars, jump scares, creaky doors, a clock striking midnight, thunder, wolves and owls. Spooky music loops; Ctrl+Alt+2 a scream, Ctrl+Alt+4 a jump scare.
